_about: Work in progress: every new map or diagram is added here first, before any work on it (the user's standing rule, 2026-09-27). tools/preview.mjs puts each item on its local copy's home page, in its section, as a card that opens whatever exists so far, or a «কাজ চলছে» page; the live home page, docs/registry.json, gets it only when it is finished, when it leaves this list for its own folder under docs/. tools/verify.mjs fails an id here that the committed registry lists or that is also a finished map or diagram. Fields: id, kind (map | diagram), section (bangladesh | international | geography | misc), title { bn, en } — the preview card's title, which may differ from the item's descriptor while it is in progress.
